text.en:
Luxembourg to Turkey Shipping — Hanbros UK

Luxembourg to Turkey shipping with Hanbros UK — compact market, full-service logistics for parcels, removals and business freight.

Our operations span Luxembourg City and the Grand Duchy. Despite Luxembourg's size, we offer regular groupage slots and dedicated support for high-value and personal shipments.

Services from Luxembourg to Turkey

  • International cargo & parcels to all Turkish cities.
  • Household removals with professional packing and customs.
  • Vehicle shipping with full export/import documentation.
  • Commercial freight for businesses and traders.
  • Express & economy options to match your budget and timeline.

Hanbros UK advantage: Whether your goods originate in Luxembourg or the UK, you receive one dedicated coordinator, one transparent quote and one trusted brand on the Europe–Turkey corridor.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you collect in Luxembourg?

Yes — we arrange collections across Luxembourg City and the Grand Duchy and coordinate transit to Turkey via our UK hub and direct routes.

How long does shipping from Luxembourg to Turkey take?

Typically 7–21 days depending on service level, route and customs — we confirm at quote stage.

Is customs included?

Export and import customs brokerage is handled by our experienced team on both sides.

Hanbros UK — your partner for Luxembourg to Turkey logistics.
